result.topic_en: Opening of Part II on transcendental functions arising from differentiating arithmetic-geometric means: defines the AGM sequences, their differentials, and the abbreviations f, g with a first recurrence for f'.
result.transcription:
16
Pars II.
De Functionibus Transscendentibus quae ex
Differentiatione mediorum arithmetico-
geometricorum oriuntur.

9. Sint
$\begin{cases} x,\ x',\ x'',\ x''' \ldots & (I) \\ y,\ y',\ y'',\ y''' \ldots & (II) \end{cases}$
series perinde formatae ut series in art. I, puta ut quivis
terminus in $\left\{ \begin{matrix} I \\ II \end{matrix} \right\}$ sit medium $\left\{ \begin{matrix} \text{arithmeticum} \\ \text{geometricum} \end{matrix} \right\}$ inter duos termi
nos praecedentes, [-patet-] adeoque $x^\infty = y^\infty = M(x,y)$: patet
que, omnes has quantitates et proin etiam ipsarum limitem
esse functiones duarum variabilium $x$, $y$, [-at-] atque vari
ari, simulac[?] harum alterutra aut utraque mutationem
patiatur. Hic vero[?] de solis mutationibus infinite parvis ser
mo erit. Fit itaque $\partial x' = \frac{1}{2}\partial x + \frac{1}{2}\partial y$, $\partial y' = \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{y}{x}}.\partial x + \frac{1}{2}\sqrt{\frac{x}{y}}.\partial y$
$= \frac{1}{2}\frac{y'}{x} + \frac{1}{2}\frac{y'}{y}\partial y$; et perinde $\partial x'' = \frac{1}{2}\partial x' + \frac{1}{2}\partial y'$, $\partial y'' = \frac{1}{2}\frac{y''}{x'}\partial x' +$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{y''}{y'}\partial y'$ etc. [-Quodsi-] Hoc modo differentialia omnium termi
norum in I et II per differentialia ipsarum $x$, $y$ adiumento
substitutionum exhiberi possent: sed lex progressionis magnopere
obscura hinc prodiret. Quam ut clarissime ob oculos produca
mus, sequentibus scribendi compendiis utemur: Scribemus
$\frac{\partial x}{x} + \frac{\partial y}{y} = f$, $\frac{\partial x'}{x'} + \frac{\partial y'}{y'} = f'$, $\frac{\partial x''}{x''} + \frac{\partial y''}{y''} = f''$ etc.; $\frac{\partial x}{x} - \frac{\partial y}{y} =$
$g$, $\frac{\partial x'}{x'} - \frac{\partial y'}{y'} = g'$, $\frac{\partial x''}{x''} - \frac{\partial y''}{y''} = g''$ etc. unde statim prodit
$f' = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{\partial x}{x'} + \frac{\partial x}{x} + \frac{\partial y}{x'} + \frac{\partial y}{y}\right) = f + \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial x}{xx'}(x - x') + \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial y}{yx'}(y - x') = f +$
$\frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial x}{xx'}(x - x') - \frac{1}{2}\frac{\partial y}{yx'}(x - x') = f + \frac{1}{2}g\frac{x - x'}{x'}$; et prorsus simili modo
